C-PLANNING-PHASE-TEACHING-1-CBE5DFAD.Problem:
The planning-phase contract is self-contradictory and carries a stale causal claim, in the canonical `ngrace-plan` teaching and its packaged mirror.
Rule 19 (`skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md:75`) instructs the planner to drive the spec's `CloseEvidence` commands "and the full CI in a faithful post-close copy at plan time, not only against the pre-close tree." Rule 20 (`:76`) says "The full CI-equivalent verification is close-time only: it runs at the plan's `TargetAssertions` `MustPassCommand` under `--assertions final --run-commands`." The two rules disagree. The rule-19 increment `efae7553e46be6bd8454bf070e43ee458b02c6ab` (C-TEACHING-CLOSE-PATH-1-3E91B69F) introduced the full-CI-at-PLAN sentence against the predecessor spec's close-time-only criterion, while `a104166b2034bb06e028598b6533c9becaeccdfb` created rule 20's close-time statement. The original purpose is sound and is retained: prototype command feasibility and faithful evidence in the state a lawful close actually produces. What is wrong is running the full CI at PLAN; the narrow `CloseEvidence` commands and structural assertion probes remain PLAN work, and the full CI-equivalent verification remains EXECUTE close-time evidence.
The same rule 19 carries an obsolete causal claim: the faithful post-close copy must carry `.ngrace/scratch` read-only "because without it `review.confidently-wrong` fires on archived plans whose `BaselineAssertions` `MustExist` the buffer path." That was true of an older review, but the current review discovers active `plan.xml` files before reading any plan content and derives the bundle location before opening it (`src/review/core.ts:504-518`), so an unrelated archived plan is opaque history and its `MustExist` buffer path is never evaluated. Authority CLI probes on a fresh synthetic project showed an active missing-scratch `MustExist` finding disappearing after exact restoration, while the archived counterpart produced no such plan finding. The historical reasoning survives only in an archived plan baseline (`.ngrace/changes/archive/C-PAIR-AUDIT-MINT-CWD-1-ED6B7D22/plan.xml:633-636`), which is passive evidence and is not current behavior. The obsolete claim must be removed or recast; the generic requirement that a faithful copy carry actual declared inputs/dependencies, applicable VCS state, and necessary ignored/untracked inputs stays, and no archive reader or repository record pipeline may be invented to replace the claim.
The teaching instrument still pins the stale cause. `scripts/check-teaching-surface.ts:456` holds the `{ skill: "ngrace-plan", section: "must_do", token: "review.confidently-wrong" }` needle, with its red-direction cases at `scripts/check-teaching-surface.test.ts:572,1009`. Correcting the teaching without correcting this needle leaves a guard that requires the false claim to remain; correcting the needle without a positive/negative pair leaves no guard that the corrected phase contract stays corrected. The repair therefore moves the needle to a token from the recast sentence and adds discriminating guards for the corrected contract and for the removed claim.
A `SKILL.md` edit moves the canonical skill-text footprint. The exact numeric pins in `src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` (`skillTextLines().total` and `totalBytes`) and the `README.md` measurement cell must be re-measured with the unchanged instrument and transcribed so pins and README agree with the measured final canonical totals; no future figure may be projected into the criteria (F272) and the D15 line/byte semantics are frozen.
Counterweights answered, not ignored. Existing spec/execute `close-time only` taught-rule pins remain intact; this bundle does not weaken prototype, planted-violation, restoration, approval, fingerprint, or lifecycle evidence, and it preserves command attribution — a declared task is established before opted-in command evidence, and supported task resolution after fold — without adding a runtime guard. Rule 6's adopter-generic close-write scope repair and rule 32's retired `change.archive-status-mismatch` teaching remain required follow-on work and are not paid here; the `ngrace status` archive-reader policy work and the live `C-ROADMAP-XML` / F177 charter conflict stay outside this slice.
